release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $321m (+40% y/y) against the company's own $304-307m guide, a record $160m of ARR added, adjusted FCF margin 41%, Q4 guided to +44-45% growth and full-year 2027 growth lifted to 60%+ from the prior >50%: a clean beat-and-raise on the guide line the stock trades on, into a 33% sector-credit drawdown, sized at about the option-implied 13% move and below the +18/+29/+40 guide-print reactions.

release.headline: DigitalOcean Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.note: bar is the midpoint of the company's own Q3 guide ($304-307m); street consensus not retrieved in time

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 6 estimates); likely not on the same basis as the company's non-GAAP figure
vs_bar.note: GAAP EPS -0.37 incl. $57m induced conversion expense; surprise not computed because the Nasdaq basis is uncertain
bar is the prior company guide $1.17-1.18bn from August (Reuters via NST, snippet_only), not current street consensus

key_line.detail: FY2027 revenue growth expected at 60% or more, up from the prior >50%; AI customer ARR $376m (+288%); total ARR $1,285m (+40%), record $160m net new ARR. Offsets: $785m equipment lease facility (more debt-like capacity funding in a neocloud credit scare) and ~$472m of 2030 converts repurchased with a concurrent registered direct equity offering (dilution).

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue $348-351m (+44-45%), non-GAAP EPS $0.30-0.32; FY26 revenue $1.208-1.211bn (+34%, from $1.17-1.18bn), EPS $1.60-1.62, adj FCF margin 20-22%; FY27 growth 60%+ (was >50%). Street Q4/FY27 figures not retrieved.

call.detail: Call was scheduled 08:00 ET today, so it took place before the open; its content was not reviewed in the time available. The pre-market range of 81.1-93.9 suggests the call or the financing details whipsawed the price.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action or news coverage of today's release found in two searches before 09:20 ET; search results were dominated by stale 2025/mid-2026 pages.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 88.0 (median of last 5) against prev close 89.79 = -2.0%; last print 88.9 at 09:11, 152 prints, 21 in the last 30 minutes, not stale. Range 81.1-93.9, so the pre-market swung both ways around a flat-to-down level. Against a +14% release read and a 13.1% implied move the market has priced almost none of the beat-and-raise, most likely because of the equity offering / lease financing or a call detail I could not read. Market: QQQ +0.7%, IWM +0.3%. Position is -2.3% vs the 91.00 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was that the CFO's September reaffirmation of Q3/FY/2027 would hold and the 33% drawdown was sector credit, not DOCN; the release beats the Q3 guide, raises FY26 and lifts 2027 to 60%+. The pre-market does not agree yet.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (21 prints in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:11) so the open should sit near the -2% reference, but the gap is small relative to a wide 81-94 range, so the open holding under half of it is quite possible; a small loss-side gap on a fundamentally strong print leans toward a partial recovery toward yesterday's close by 10:00.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn duidelijk sterk (omzet ruim boven de eigen prognose, prognose voor 2026 en 2027 verhoogd) en bevestigen de these, maar de koers staat voorbeurs nog ongeveer 2% lager. Bij een ochtendmelding verwerkt de markt het nieuws vaak de hele dag door, en analisten die hun koersdoel verhogen moeten nog komen; daarom houden tot het slot in plaats van om 13:00 te verkopen. Het risico is dat de aandelenuitgifte en de leaseschuld de reden van de daling zijn en die blijft hangen.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 verder wegzakt richting de voorbeurslaagste stand rond 81 of er nieuws komt dat het gesprek met beleggers negatief was (bijvoorbeeld over de aandelenuitgifte), dan om 10:00 verkopen in plaats van tot het slot houden.
